discovery_notes: Follow-up 2 of B018 (after 426). 29 standard WebSearch queries, blocked domains passed or allowed_domains limited to preferred sites. Evidence almost entirely Disney Pins Blog weekly roundups and event posts. New: SW Pin of the Month 11 (Endor), Celebration Orlando park pins, Candlelight Processional, Jungle Cruise 45th, PODH, shared DL/WDW monthly LEs (Mother's Day, Graduation, Olaf, Hercules, Doorways, Oswald, Essence of Evil Gaston, Force Friday II), Easter Bean Bunny. Gaston keyed on existing dlr/2017/essence-of-evil set. No holds released. Resellers (yourwdwstore) seen, not used. No prompt-injection seen.
